newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - BANK SHARES RISE FURTHER.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK - BANK SHARES RISE FURTHER.

text.p: Banking shares extended their gains for a second week running on the Botswana Stock Exchange last week with Barclays adding 10 thebe and First National and Standard Chartered each putting on five thebe.
Inco and Realestate Development also each gained five thebe.
Down on the week was Kgolo ya Sechaba, shedding five thebe.
Untraded were Engen, Pep and Sefalana.
Volume on the week was sharply lower with 40,955 shares valued at 209,379 pula changing hands compared with the 295,916 shares valued at 681.846 pula which traded the previous week.
The index edged up 0.41 points to close at 347.03 points.
